```sql
SELECT
    d.batter,
    SUM(d.batter_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs IN (4, 6) THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs IN (4, 6) THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(d.batter_runs), 0),
        2
    ) AS boundary_share_percent
FROM deliveries d
GROUP BY d.batter
HAVING SUM(d.batter_runs) >= 1000
ORDER BY boundary_share_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
